UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; V=$(curl -fsSL https://lacrimesonline.com/builds/ | grep -oE 'LAC_Linux_v[0-9.]*[0-9][.]zip' | sed -E 's/^LAC_Linux_v//; s/[.]zip$//' | sort -uV | tail -n 1); if [ -z \"$V\" ]; then echo 'Could not find a Linux server build on lacrimesonline.com/builds'; exit 1; fi; if [ -f LACServer.x86_64 ] && [ \"$(cat version.txt 2>/dev/null)\" = \"$V\" ]; then echo \"Server v$V is already installed\"; exit 0; fi; echo \"Downloading server v$V\"; rm -rf lac_update; mkdir lac_update; curl -fsSL -o lac_update/server.zip \"https://lacrimesonline.com/builds/LAC_Linux_v$V.zip\"; unzip -q -o lac_update/server.zip -d lac_update/files; rm -f lac_update/server.zip; rm -rf LACServer_Data; mv \"lac_update/files/LAC_Linux_v${V}_Data\" LACServer_Data; mv \"lac_update/files/LAC_Linux_v${V}.x86_64\" LACServer.x86_64; cp -rf lac_update/files/. .; rm -rf lac_update; chmod +x LACServer.x86_64; echo \"$V\" > version.txt; echo \"Installed server v$V\""
